subject: Tyska
title: Vocabulary: travel and weather
sourceSummary: Words for travel, modes of transport, and talking about the weather.

questions.prompt: What does "die Hin- und Rückfahrkarte" mean?
questions.explanation: "Hin- und Rückfahrkarte" is a round-trip ticket. A one-way ticket is "eine Einzelfahrkarte".

questions.prompt: You're at the airport looking for "den Koffer". What are you looking for?
questions.opener: Something you pack before a trip.
questions.explanation: "Der Koffer" is the suitcase. "Der Reisepass" is the passport, and "der Ausgang" is the exit.

questions.prompt: What does "Es ist heute sehr warm" mean?
questions.opener: A simple weather expression with "es ist".
questions.explanation: "Es ist warm" means "it's warm". "Sehr" intensifies it to "very warm".

questions.prompt: Choose the right weather word: "Es ___ viel im Herbst." (It rains a lot in the fall.)
questions.opener: Rain has its own verb in German.
questions.explanation: "Regnen" (to rain) is conjugated "es regnet" in the third person. "Schneien" (to snow) follows a similar pattern: "es schneit".

questions.prompt: What do you ask if you want to know where the train departs from?
choices: Von wo fährt der Zug ab?
questions.explanation: "Von wo fährt der Zug ab?" means "where does the train depart from?". "Wann kommt ... an?" instead asks when it ARRIVES.

questions.prompt: Write the German phrase for "it's sunny" (three words: "es ist ...").
Correct the error: "Der Zug fährt um acht Uhr ab und kommt zehn Uhr an." (The train departs at eight o'clock and arrives at ten o'clock.)
questions.opener: "Ankommen" needs the preposition "um" before the time.
questions.answer: Der Zug fährt um acht Uhr ab und kommt um zehn Uhr an.
steps: "Kommt zehn Uhr an" is missing the preposition "um" before the time.
Correct form: "kommt um zehn Uhr an" — just like "fährt um acht Uhr ab" uses "um" before the time.
Full sentence: "Der Zug fährt um acht Uhr ab und kommt um zehn Uhr an."

questions.prompt: Which travel and weather expressions should you know at grade 9 level in German?
questions.opener: Booking, traveling, and talking about the weather.
questions.answer: Travel: die Fahrkarte (Einzel-/Hin- und Rückfahrkarte) = ticket (one-way/round-trip) · der Koffer = suitcase · der Reisepass = passport · der Zug/das Flugzeug/der Bus = train/plane/bus · abfahren = to depart · ankommen = to arrive · Von wo fährt...ab? = Where does... depart from? Weather: es ist warm/kalt/sonnig/windig = it's warm/cold/sunny/windy · es regnet = it's raining · es schneit = it's snowing · es ist bewölkt = it's cloudy.
